blockingFindings.description: Across the V124 direct renders, the lower bodice still shows visible triangular faceting around the front and side waist; the lowered all-jacket surface-placement ramp did not make a visible improvement.
Side and rear views still show the jacket hem projecting outward at the waist, with a pinched and uneven layered transition.
Crouch, sit, and prone views still show folded or tangled skirt strips and a cone/disk-like silhouette. Pleats and lamé/fencing-practice identity are not clear in the rendered garment.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
